subject: c-fo-act
title: C.FO.ACT.------DYM.F.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 341 (PCC-25). C-FO-ACT (composite focused activism) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) is the partner. From the subject: INT (intention), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From DYM-F: VT-U-PT (vibrational universe particulars). From INT: DYM-F and PHY-U-P (physical universe particular). From VT-U-PT: EXT-DYM (extended dynamics), C-CONT (composite continuance) and TR (transformation). From PHY-U-P: PR-TRS. From TR: INFO-DE (information degrees), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", and MT-INFO (multi-information).
